MealChef UI JSON Schemas

# **PHASE A: ONBOARDING (ONE-TIME SETUP)**

The onboarding flow walks the user through questions to understand their tastes, restrictions, goals, and routine. This data is collected once and used as long-term context.

## **SCREEN 1: Welcome**

App entry point with Sign Up, Log In, and social auth options (Google / Facebook).

| :---: | :---- |

# **PHASE B: PRE-MEAL DECISION**

The user types or speaks what they are considering eating. The system parses this into structured items and tags.

## **SCREEN 5: What are you in the mood for?**

Captures the user's current mood, hunger levels, and cravings before deciding on a meal.

| ![](data:image/png;base64,) | Schema: PreMealMood {   "title": "PreMealMood",   "type": "object",   "properties": { 	"user\_id": {   	"type": "string" 	}, 	"voice\_input": {   	"type": "string" 	}, 	"eating\_reason": {   	"type": "string" 	}, 	"current\_hunger": {   	"type": "integer",   	"minimum": 1,   	"maximum": 10 	}, 	"target\_fullness": {   	"type": "integer",   	"minimum": 1,   	"maximum": 10 	}, 	"cravings": {   	"type": "array",   	"items": {     	"type": "string"   	} 	}   },   "required": \[ 	"user\_id"   \] } Fields: Field Type Required Description user\_id string Yes Unique user identifier voice\_input string No Voice transcript eating\_reason string No Selected reason for eating current\_hunger integer No 1-10 slider value target\_fullness integer No 1-10 slider value cravings array No Selected craving chips  |
| :---: | :---- |
